messages.message: One provider and one model are active at a time.

Fill in the endpoint for a well-known provider. The endpoint is the full URL, including the path (e.g. /v1/chat/completions); see the help page for details. For OpenAI, Chat Completions works with almost every model; the newer Responses API is only needed for some of OpenAI's newest models.

Tick this if the assistant cannot reach this provider even though the endpoint and key are correct.

Requests normally go out through your browser, which is usually the better choice — it already knows your proxy settings, your organization’s certificates, and your sign-in. But some providers refuse requests made that way (a browser rule called CORS), and the only symptom is a network error.

With this ticked, InterSpec makes the request itself instead, using {1}. Leave it off for providers that work.

Not available in this build — {1}.

Requests to this provider will go through the browser, so if it refuses them (CORS), it cannot be reached from this installation.
Only needed if a CORS-fix provider cannot get through your network.

Leave empty unless told otherwise: InterSpec already follows the proxy configured in your system settings, including automatic (PAC/WPAD) discovery.

Set it only if that discovery does not work, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080.

This platform’s HTTP client ({1}) cannot be pointed at a specific proxy.

Set the proxy in your system settings instead, or ask your IT department whether one is required.

A PEM file, or a folder of them, to trust in addition to the ones this computer already trusts.

Needed on networks that inspect encrypted traffic, where your organization’s certificate has not been installed system-wide. Your IT department can supply the file.

Turns off verification of the server’s identity, so the connection can no longer be trusted to reach the real provider.

Use only to confirm a certificate problem is the cause, then add the certificate above instead.
Anyone on the network can read or alter these requests, including your API key.
Save each assistant conversation to an XML file.

When checked, the full conversation — your messages, the assistant’s replies, tool calls and their results — is written to a file at the end of every turn. Clearing the conversation starts a new file.

Logs may contain spectrum details, file names, and analysis results, and are never deleted automatically.
